whatIs.title: What is Developer Cheatsheet?
whatIs.description: A comprehensive reference tool with 218 essential commands across Git, Linux, Docker, SQL, Vim, HTTP Status Codes, CSS Flexbox/Grid, and Regex. Quickly search, copy, and bookmark the commands you need.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: Select a category tab at the top to browse by topic
Type in the search bar to filter commands in real-time
Click the copy button next to any command to copy to clipboard
Star frequently used commands for quick access
Click a command to see usage examples and tags

tips.title: Tips
items: Add this page to your browser bookmarks for quick terminal reference
Search works in both Korean and English
Use the difficulty filter to learn basic commands first
